name: Flaming Sphere
summary: Creates a rolling sphere of fire that burns creatures near it.

stats.effect:
You create a 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire in an unoccupied space on the ground within range. It lasts for the duration. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the sphere makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

As a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}, you can move the sphere up to 30 feet, rolling it along the ground. If you move the sphere into a creature's space, that creature makes the save against the sphere, and the sphere stops moving for the turn.

When you move the sphere, you can direct it over barriers up to 5 feet tall and jump it across pits up to 10 feet wide. Flammable objects that aren't being worn or carried start burning if touched by the sphere, and it sheds {ref:glossary/bright-light} in a 20-foot radius and {ref:glossary/dim-light} for an additional 20 feet.
stats.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 2.
